dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there anything of note nearby?

dialogues.speaker: Viljami
dialogues.text: There are cathedrals everywhere for those with eyes to see. True noteworthy treasures lie in finding peace within life's quiet moments — not in clinging to worldly things. Contentment is the rarest joy, my friend.

dialogues.speaker: Viljami
dialogues.text: As long as I can sleep soundly and dream at night, then wake up well-rested to greet each new day... Well, that's all I ask for.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Maybe you should ask for more...

dialogues.speaker: Viljami
dialogues.text: And maybe I shouldn't. Once a person has everything they need to live a stable, peaceful life, why should they keep yearning for more?

dialogues.speaker: Viljami
dialogues.text: I used to be filled with ambition, but misdirected aspiration ruined my life... I lost every penny I ever had, and worse, thanks to smuggling, I lost my freedom, and thanks to that shipwreck, I lost my family.

dialogues.speaker: Viljami
dialogues.text: Back here in the present, I have nothing, but at least that means I have nothing to lose.

dialogues.speaker: Viljami
dialogues.text: Don't you agree?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: When you put it like that...

dialogues.speaker: Viljami
dialogues.text: People are always looking for more, but we all have limits on what we can achieve. For most of us, our ambition inevitably outgrows our potential.

dialogues.speaker: Viljami
dialogues.text: That's why ambition — and desire — are so dangerous.

dialogues.speaker: Viljami
dialogues.text: Imagine you were climbing a summitless mountain — no matter how high you climb, you're eventually going to die on the mountain slopes or plunge to your death down below.

dialogues.speaker: Viljami
dialogues.text: You've got to know when to stop. That's the secret to happiness.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye. I wish you a stable, peaceful day.

dialogues.speaker: Viljami
dialogues.text: The same to you, child.

dialogues.speaker: Viljami
dialogues.text: (<color=#FFCC33FF>Nefer</color> appears to have something on her mind...)

dialogues.speaker: Viljami
dialogues.text: Lady Nefer, what brings you here? I'm all out of chips — I'm afraid I can't join you for a hand.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Be that as it may, you're still a skilled player, aren't you?

dialogues.speaker: Viljami
dialogues.text: I'm sorry, Lady Nefer, but I no longer yearn for... the things I once desired.

dialogues.speaker: Viljami
dialogues.text: All I seek is a quiet life and to enjoy the things I have.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Very well. I, too, hope you can find true peace, Mr. Viljami.

dialogues.speaker: Viljami
dialogues.text: Hehe, I'm sure I will... No, I'm sure we will all find true peace, someday.
